## Decisions
- Package name: offgrid-ai (confirmed available on npm)
- Data dir: ~/.offgrid-ai/
- Install: npm install -g offgrid-ai
- Target user: non-developer first — opinionated, zero config, hide complexity
- Model downloads: out of scope — LM Studio, Ollama, oMLX handle that
- One model at a time — laptop RAM constraint
- Command files: JSON (kills shell parser, still editable)
- Auto-detect everything from GGUF metadata: QAT, MTP, thinking, vision — no user choices
- Sampling/flags: computed from metadata, no guided questions, power users edit JSON
- Presets: gone, replaced by auto-detect
- Harness: Pi only. Not installed → offer to install. OpenCode deprecated.
- Backend install: single choice — LM Studio (recommended), Ollama, oMLX, or all three
- Benchmark: always visible option. Repo not found → offer to clone. Repeats every time.
- Config: ~/.offgrid-ai/config.json surfaces auto-detected paths, editable for overrides
- Model scan dirs: ~/.lmstudio/models/, ~/.cache/huggingface/, common paths + custom in config
- Update checks: active prompt on startup via update-notifier
- MTP: auto-detected option, same Homebrew binary, different flags
